run_train_loop: run the main training loop with an experiment class, config, checkpointer, and writer
run_evaluation_loop: run the evaluation loop that monitors checkpoints and saves the best model
initialize_experiment: initialize an experiment instance with backward-compatible init_rng support
log_training_outputs: log scalar training outputs at periodic intervals during training
save_best_checkpoint: save a best checkpoint when the evaluation metric improves over previous best
